nodes.label: Demo Mode
nodes.rationale: Provides a deterministic template generator and source matching for local use.

nodes.label: Durable Generation Queue
nodes.rationale: Serializes inference, identifies attempts with a document and idempotency key, and preserves teacher edits by checking the working revision.

nodes.label: NestJS Feature Modules
nodes.rationale: Controllers handle HTTP and delegate to services and persistence.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Index
nodes.rationale: Rebuildable vector index keyed by PostgreSQL chunk ID.

nodes.label: Source Scoped Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Filters by document and selected source IDs, then validates the returned chunk IDs against PostgreSQL.

nodes.label: Standalone Angular Feature Screens
nodes.rationale: Colocates each feature template and stylesheet with its component.

nodes.label: Student and Teacher Export Projections
nodes.rationale: Keeps answer keys, scoring, citations and review notes in the teacher copy.
